Ancient Tomb.description:
A silent chamber of white stone. In the center lies the golden sarcophagus where Golden Bat slept for 10,000 years, its lid cracked in two upon the floor.
[marie3]Marie sits beside it, her father's waterlogged notes spread across her lap...

secrets.text: You walk to the back of the tomb and see a small crack in the wall, leading north to some secret room...

Echoing Gallery.description:
The room is filled with ancient wooden frames.
Instead of statues, you see a series of painted boards depicting a golden figure saving children from monsters.
A faint smell of candy fills the air — a memory of the sweets sold to children before the show began.
A plaque reads: 'Before the screen, there was the paper. Before the comic, there was the street...'

Secret Tunnel.description: A narrow, damp passageway lit by faint bioluminescent moss. Fresh bootprints in the mud lead toward the tomb...

Shipwrecked Beach.description: White sands littered with the wreckage of Professor Mire's ship. The Pacific waves crash against jagged rocks, and gulls pick at what the sea has left behind...

extra.text: Giant trenches scar the sand where Five Finger dragged itself back into the sea.

Ocean-Facing Cliffs.description: High, windswept precipices overlooking the vast ocean. From here, you can see the faint glimmer of the lost city below...

extra.text: Something red flutters on a ledge far below.

secrets.text: Far below, on a ledge battered by spray, a crimson cape is snagged on the rocks. No hand could reach it... but perhaps the wind could.

interactions.text: You raise the Kinesis Stone. The wind obeys. A howling updraft tears the crimson cape from the rocks and lays it at your feet.

Abandoned Residential District.description: Crumbling stone houses that once housed the people of Atlantis. Vines choke the ancient architecture, and lanterns still hang in the doorways, unlit for ten thousand years...

Rusted Armory.description: A chamber filled with decayed bronze weapons and empty racks that once held the military might of a lost empire. A towering bronze sentinel stands at the far wall, spear in hand...

Abandoned Church.description: A towering structure with vaulted ceilings. Ancient symbols are carved into the stone, and a cold draft rises from the stairs leading down...

Church Cellar.description: A dark, cramped basement filled with crates of old scrolls and strange, humming minerals. Fresh drill holes pock the walls. Something has been digging...

Ancient Atlantean Lab.description: A massive hall filled with advanced machinery and glowing crystalline computers from a forgotten science. Nazō's men have bolted crude cables into the ancient consoles...

South.blocked_text: The floor to the south has collapsed into a black chasm. The far side is too distant to leap... but something might fly across.
South.pass_text: The Red Cape snaps open like the wings of a great bat, and you glide across the chasm.

East.blocked_text: A wall of crackling spectral energy seals the eastern hall. Somewhere behind it, a man is laughing.

Submerged Observation Deck.description: A glass-domed room beneath the waves. You can see the aquatic life of Atlantis swimming past the reinforced glass...

extra.text: Something vast moves in the deep, just beyond sight. You are not yet ready to face it.
